summary: testSettingsAnalyticsPreferenceStopsReportingAndPersistsBothStates exercises the real AppModel.analyticsEnabled binding (same code path as the Settings Toggle) through both false->true and true->false transitions, and forces fresh AnalyticsService instances to re-read the shared UserDefaults suite, which fails under plausible violations (ignoring stored value, always defaulting true/false, or not persisting a transition); no over-mocking beyond the external PostHog client, no tautologies found.
